intentional_source_repairs.evidence_status: Pristine and corrected source cases, regression guards and target replay pending completion.

protocol_companion_policy: Record method-specific HEAD/ordinary OPTIONS and unsupported-method precedence before finalizing dispatch; reuse shared CORS/session behavior. Class permissions precede timezone; action decorators follow timezone. No implicit authorization bypass for an unsupported method.

differential_replay.environment: Compare immutable baseline and candidate production proxies with equivalent isolated PostgreSQL seeds, separate Redis namespaces and RabbitMQ vhosts, DEBUG=False, identical configured WEB_URL and explicit API-key throttle. Detail samples name a missing invitation or member; bodyless collection mutations do not accept invitations or add projects, and leave names the sole administrator. Successful mutations and durable effects are established by fixture replay. Preserved source serves selected Django paths while baseline Go serves already-retired paths.

middleware_details.api-key-invitations: Request size, API-key authentication on primary, class authorization, timezone, dispatch, audit. BaseViewSet does not use API-key rate throttling.
middleware_details.api-key-rosters: Request size, API-key authentication on replica, class authorization, rate throttling, timezone, dispatch, audit.
middleware_details.django-session: Request size and inspected session, class permissions, timezone, action authorization and dispatch; source decorators determine cache invalidation timing. Audit runs when an API key header is present, including session requests.

workspace-invitation-mail.contract: Persistent celery delivery after bulk insertion, including source conflict-ignored inputs; arguments contain email, workspace ID, token, configured origin and inviter email.

project-invitation-mail.contract: ACCESS-001 corrected registered task after whole-batch validation and bulk insertion; exact payload and delivery compared against corrected source.

event-tracking.contract: Source branch-specific user_invited_to_workspace or user_joined_workspace task; exact kwargs, persistence and order compared against source.

soft-delete.contract: Instance soft-delete branches publish model and object identity with using=null. QuerySet bulk deletion remains distinct and must not invent instance tasks.

api-audit.contract: Any request carrying an API key header publishes the source redacted audit task when it reaches audit middleware, including resolver rejection on the Django fallback. Exact response, normalized request peer and keyed identifier are replayed.
